items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Then I played with uh, uh, Ridgely, William Ridgely, used to live on Edinburgh Street.

ctx.x: Who was playing drums. And uh, David Jones, who was the managing band playing piano. And uh, April Associates was playing alto. And I left there. And I come up to uh, uh, uh, I got a job at Laiola and 8th, what they call Chinatown. Well I built up a name for myself, you know, through that. And then uh, ending out I was playing with Celestane's band, Papa Celestane. But I'd go back to my own outfit. Then I played with uh, uh, Ridgely, William Ridgely, used to live on Edinburgh Street.
